_about: Which facts a cruise line carries in the Lexicon. So far one (Track C7b): beverage_gratuity_rate, the fraction a line adds to a beverage package price. Operator ruling 2026-10-31 (memory 446c35a2): the gratuity is knowledge that can go stale and must be marked as such, so it carries ttl_days 90 (LEXICON-PLAN-3.1 section 6, cruise.line: prices 90d) and Project-Sophos sophos/src/lexicon/freshness.mjs reads it stale once that long has passed since its last check. A line whose package prices already include the gratuity, or that adds none, files no rate: a stored 0 there means 'nothing is added on top', not '0 percent gratuity'. Identity: line:<id>, the line's id in brands.json (assets/data/lexicon/line-aliases.json). Soli Deo Gloria.
